title: Mirabel and the Alibi
author: Petra Nakamura
blurb: Yara Okafor, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
